primary_endpoint: conditional penalized IoU on bbox-bearing images, averaged within study_id and then across studies

proposed_model.architecture: ResNet18-FPN with zero-DC morphological context, adaptive scale-reliability fusion, center-size box decoder, and learned residual-risk head

comparator_contract.claim_scope: retrospective conditional comparison against the current frozen implementations only

threshold_policy.proposed_method: conditional center-size decoder is threshold-free; a presence threshold is selected on calibration only for the secondary system output
threshold_policy.comparators: frozen inherited thresholds; original selection partition cannot be reconstructed

evaluation_partitions.external_cbis_ddsm: external retrospective CBIS-DDSM Calc-Test domain-shift evaluation

statistical_analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction within declared paired comparator family
statistical_analysis.interpretation: a positive mean difference without a positive lower confidence bound is not reported as statistically established superiority

lineage_contract.exact_method_seed_grid: 4 methods x 3 seeds per evaluated split

known_evidence_limits: the partition named locked_test is not confirmatory
patient-level independence is not established from available identifiers
the local annotation snapshot differs from the earlier source-manifest digest
the proposed decoder predicts at most two boxes while a small number of images have more than two reference boxes
CBIS-DDSM ROI-mask DICOM images are converted to bounding boxes solely for external localization evaluation and are not used for training or segmentation evaluation
residual-risk is an experimental localization-error proxy, not clinically calibrated uncertainty
comparisons do not establish superiority over the Grad-CAM, Score-CAM, or U-Net families in general
claim_boundary: Permitted claims are restricted to numerical means, paired intervals, and current frozen implementations on the declared retrospective evidence. No confirmatory, clinical, patient-independent, calibrated-uncertainty, state-of-the-art, or universal-superiority claim is permitted.
